Name: Galaxy Sword Replacer - Masamune
Author: ColdTyrant
Description:
[size=5][u]DESCRIPTION

[/u][/size][size=3]This is a simple "texture" replacer for the Galaxy Sword which makes it look like the Masamune from Chrono Trigger. I haven't figured out how to rename it yet, but once I do, I'll do that as well. Possibly make it an optional file(?)[/size]

[u]INSTALL[/u]

[size=3] - Drag and drop the contents of the .zip file into your Steam\steamapps\common\StardewValley folder[/size]

[size=3] - When asked to overwrite, click yes
[/size]

Downloads.Description: Drag and drop into Stardew Valley folder. When asked to overwrite click yes
